# Implementation Plan: Cross-engine ralph-overview consumer wrapper (template-sourced) via overview-init
<!-- ralph-meta {"overviewTaskId":"ralph-overview-init-consumer-cross-engine-wrapper"} -->


*Generated by `/plan-with-ralph --from-brainstorm` on 2026-06-06. Ready for `/implement-with-ralph --from-plan .ralph/jobs/ralph-overview-init-consumer-cross-engine-wrapper/plan.md`. Converged after a 3-way plan review (Claude + Codex + Copilot); 15 findings (1 Critical, 5 High, 9 Medium) addressed — see the collapsed review block at the bottom.*

## Overview

Today every consumer of the `ralph-overview` plugin must hand-author a per-repo resolver wrapper (`bin/ralph-overview.mjs`) so its `package.json` scripts (`overview`, `overview:build`, `sync-ralph-state`, `sync-ralph-state:watch`) work under **both** Claude Code and Copilot CLI. codexu is the only consumer and carries ~170 LoC of untested wrapper with two latent bugs. This plan implements brainstorm direction **D-001**: ship the cross-engine resolver as **one self-contained, unit-tested TEMPLATE file** owned by the plugin (`templates/consumer-ralph-overview.mjs`), have `overview-init` copy it verbatim into the consumer (default `bin/ralph-overview.mjs`) **and** point the package scripts at it in a single coupled operation, fix the two latent bugs, and add a `.ralph-overview/config.json` hook so codexu's last non-generic behavior moves out of bespoke wrapper code. The plugin bumps v2.8.1 → **v2.9.0**.

The work spans **two repos** and ships as **two Ralph jobs**: **Job A** ships the plugin change in the `ai-developer-toolkit` submodule; **Job B** adopts it in codexu. Job B depends on Job A shipping to the marketplace and the codexu gitlink being bumped.

This plan makes the two decisions the brainstorm required:
- **Reconciliation decision: DIAGNOSTIC-ONLY** (no auto-`npm install`), **plus a prerequisite lazy-load fix** so one-shot `sync` actually works without chokidar, and a recommendation to **archive** the sibling task `ralph-overview-wrapper-auto-bootstrap-deps` as superseded. (See Approach → Reconciliation.)
- **Dual-repo decision: TWO Ralph jobs** (A = plugin, B = codexu adoption), B-after-A.

## Research Findings

### Codebase Context
*(Seeded from `.ralph/brainstorms/ralph-overview-init-consumer-cross-engine-wrapper/selected-direction.md`. Grounded by 4 research streams — Explore researcher + Explore architect + Copilot xhigh + Codex xhigh — and hardened by a 3-way plan review.)*

**Plugin repo (`ai-developer-toolkit/plugins/ralph-overview/`):**
- `scripts/init-consumer.mjs` — `PACKAGE_SCRIPTS` (`:10-15`) hard-codes `node $CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/ralph-overview/bin/ralph-overview.mjs <sub> --repo .` for the 4 managed scripts. `initConsumer()` (`:28-76`) plans ops then writes them **one-by-one** (`:43-63`) — best-effort, NOT all-or-nothing. **`force` flows into `planTemplate` for `.ralph-overview/data.json` (`:97`) AND `.ralph-overview/config.json` (`:98`)**; `planTemplate` (`:126-137`) overwrites on `force`, and **errors on conflicting content when not forced** (`:134`). `planPackageJsonScripts()` spread-merges only its 4 keys over existing (`:155-165`). All writes go through `atomicWriteFile`.
- `bin/ralph-overview.mjs` (dispatcher) routes `init|install-server|sync|watch|dev|build|mcp|cli` (`:18-59`); `cli derive-next-command` → `scripts/lib/derive-next-command-cli.mjs`. CLI `init` supports `--add-package-json-scripts`, `--dry-run`, `--json`; **no `--diff`**.
- `scripts/sync-ralph-state.mjs:13` **statically** imports `start` from `scripts/lib/watch-ralph-state.mjs`, which at `:6` **statically** imports `{ watch } from 'chokidar'`. So **every** `sync` (even one-shot, no `--watch`) loads chokidar at module-eval time → a fresh Copilot install without `node_modules` fails even for non-watch sync.
- `scripts/lib/atomic-write.mjs` (`:8-31`) — per-file atomic only (tmp + fsync + rename-with-retry). No cross-file transaction.
- `scripts/lib/resolve-config.mjs` — config-path precedence: explicit `configPath` > `OVERVIEW_CONFIG_PATH` (repoRoot-relative) > `.ralph-overview/config.json` > legacy (`:38-60`). **Array values REPLACE on merge, not append** (`:105-116`). Tolerates unknown root keys at runtime.
- `templates/overview-config.template.json` (`:1-66`) + `templates/overview-config.schema.json` — the schema has **`"additionalProperties": false`** (`:6`), so any new config key must be added to the schema or consumer config validation breaks.
- `scripts/lib/derive-next-command-cli.mjs:19` — defaults snapshot to the **stale** `plans/overview-snapshot.json` unless `--snapshot` is supplied. The file does not currently import `loadConfig`.
- `skills/overview-init/SKILL.md` (+ generated mirror `.copilot-plugin/copilot-skills/overview-init/SKILL.md`, regenerated by `scripts/generate-copilot-artifacts.mjs --write`) documents `--add-package-json-scripts` as "only adds scripts" and `--force` as "overwrites scaffold data/config only" — both become inaccurate once the flag emits a wrapper.
- `launch.cjs` stages only `scripts`, `tools`, `package.json` into the MCP build cache (not `templates/`); init-consumer resolves the real tree via `RALPH_OVERVIEW_PLUGIN_ROOT`, so templates still resolve — but this must be verified for MCP-driven `overview.init`.

**codexu repo:**
- `bin/ralph-overview.mjs:16-170` — resolver cascade. **BUG #1**: `existsPluginAt` requires `node_modules/chokidar` (`:53-56`) → a real Copilot install (no `node_modules/`) is judged "not usable" and silently skipped. **BUG #2**: `newestVersionedSubdir` uses lexical `entries.sort()` (`:58-68`) → `2.10.0 < 2.9.0` picks an older cache. Deltas: `withCodexuCliDefaults` `--snapshot` injection (`:159-170`); script-relative submodule local-dev fallback (`:95-103`). Already wires `OVERVIEW_CONFIG_PATH` to child env when `.ralph-overview/config.json` exists (`:146-153`).
- `package.json:11-16` — **six** scripts call `node bin/ralph-overview.mjs ...` (`overview`, `overview:dev`, `overview:build`, `overview:build:preview`, `sync-ralph-state`, `sync-ralph-state:watch`); they already point at the LOCAL `bin/` wrapper, not `$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT`. The plugin manages only 4 of these.
- `.ralph-overview/config.json` exists with `outputs.snapshot = .ralph-overview/generated/snapshot.json` (= the path codexu's wrapper injects via `--snapshot`) and **no** `consumerWrapper` block. Contains 135 hand-curated tasks in `data.json` — **must not be overwritten** by adoption.
- `AGENTS.md` active-plugin-versions table pins ralph-overview `2.8.1`. `.gitignore` does **not** ignore `/bin` (wrapper-retirement removed it).

### Technical Constraints
- The emitted wrapper **cannot import plugin code** — its entire job is to locate the plugin. Marketplace name (`ai-developer-toolkit`) + plugin name (`ralph-overview`) must be baked in at **emit-time substitution** (current `planTemplate` is a literal copy, so a substitution variant is needed) or read from a constant block.
- Semver compare must be **inline** (no runtime dependency) in the template.
- New `.ralph-overview/config.json` keys require updates to **both** `overview-config.template.json` and `overview-config.schema.json` (`additionalProperties:false`).
- MCP `overview.init` schema is strict (`tools/overview-mcp/src/schemas.ts`); flag/behavior changes must update schema + `.d.mts` + tests + docs in lockstep, and keep the **CLI / MCP-shim / shared-engine parity test** (`tools/overview-mcp/src/__tests__/init-consumer.test.ts`) green.
- Plugin-local tests run via `npm run test:lib` (Vitest over `scripts/lib/*.test.mjs` and `scripts/lib/__tests__/`); a new test file must be globbed/wired into `test:lib`. Hermetic patterns to copy: `resolve-config.test.mjs` (mkdtemp + fake worktree), `resolveConfig.legacyFallback.test.mjs` (env save/restore + warn spy), `derive-next-command-cli.test.mjs` (`spawnSync` subprocess).
- Version lockstep (plugin invariant #6): `plugin.json` + 3 marketplace indexes + CHANGELOG + codexu AGENTS.md table; `tools/validate-codex-marketplace-policy.mjs` guards the `.agents` index enum (release Pre-flight).
- Submodule edits use a **two-commit flow** (commit/push the toolkit submodule first, then bump the codexu gitlink) and multi-remote push (`origin`, `personal`, `gim-home`; `gim-home` gates `copilot plugin update`).

## Approach

### Architecture
1. **Single template, exported pure resolver.** `templates/consumer-ralph-overview.mjs` is built by **thinning** codexu's current `bin/ralph-overview.mjs` (not from scratch). It exports a pure `resolvePluginRoot({ env, homedir, cwd, config })` returning `{ pluginRoot, source, depsMissing }`. Dispatch runs only under a **correct** ESM main-module guard: `fileURLToPath(import.meta.url) === path.resolve(process.argv[1])` (NOT `import.meta.url === process.argv[1]`, which compares a `file://` URL to a path and is always false). Use `realpathSync` on both sides if symlinked installs are a concern. Marketplace/plugin names are injected by **emit-time substitution** in init-consumer (one source of truth).
2. **Liveness = manifest + dispatcher.** An install is "usable" when it has `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` **and** `bin/ralph-overview.mjs`. The `node_modules/chokidar` check is removed (Bug #1). When the selected install is missing runtime deps, the wrapper **still selects it, dispatches anyway**, and prints a precise diagnostic: `installed but dependencies missing — run \`copilot plugin update\` / \`npm install\` in <pluginRoot>`. Exit codes preserved: `2` = total cascade miss, `3` = found-but-missing-dispatcher; **no new hard-fail code** for deps-missing.
3. **Semver-aware version selection** (Bug #2). Replace lexical sort with a tiny inline numeric semver comparator (`major.minor.patch`), lexical only as a final tie-break for non-semver names. So `2.10.0 > 2.9.0`.
4. **Coupled emit of wrapper + scripts, with a verifiable safety invariant** (NOT an over-claim of cross-file transactional atomicity). init-consumer gains a single planned **group** that emits the wrapper file AND the 4 package-script mutations, with this ordering contract: **plan both → preflight (if either cannot be planned, write NEITHER) → write the wrapper file (via `atomicWriteFile`) FIRST → only after the wrapper write succeeds, write the package.json script mutation.** Consequence: the package scripts are *never* updated unless the wrapper file already exists, so the dangerous half-state ("scripts point at a missing wrapper") is impossible; a failure after the wrapper write leaves the wrapper present and scripts unchanged (the safe half). If `package.json` is absent, **skip BOTH**. New `PACKAGE_SCRIPTS` form: `node bin/ralph-overview.mjs <sub> --repo .`. The `addPackageJsonScripts` flag **keeps its name** but its meaning becomes the coupled "wrapper + scripts" bundle; default stays `false` so existing `overview.init` callers are unaffected until they opt in.
5. **Wrapper emit force-scoping is INDEPENDENT of the scaffold templates** (data/config). The coupled wrapper+scripts operation must have its own overwrite policy so a consumer can (re-)emit the wrapper without forcing `.ralph-overview/data.json`/`config.json`. Re-emitting an unchanged wrapper is a no-op (skip-if-identical); re-emitting a changed wrapper overwrites only the wrapper file. **`overview-init --force` must NOT be the mechanism codexu uses to update its wrapper**, because `force` reaches the data/config scaffold templates and would overwrite codexu's 135-task `data.json` (see Reconciliation/Job B and the Risk section).
6. **Config hook for the one remaining consumer-specific behavior.** Add a `consumerWrapper` block to `.ralph-overview/config.json` (template + schema): initially **just** `{ localDevPluginRootRel: string }` (the script-relative submodule fallback). `additionalProbePaths` is **deferred** — no current consumer needs it and it adds resolver-precedence + validation surface; document it as a future extension only. The emitted wrapper reads its config through a single small helper `loadConsumerWrapperConfig(repoRoot, env)` that resolves the config path with the **same precedence the plugin uses**: honor `env.OVERVIEW_CONFIG_PATH` (repoRoot-relative) if set, else `<repoRoot>/.ralph-overview/config.json`; it then passes that **same** path down to the child as `OVERVIEW_CONFIG_PATH` so wrapper and plugin always read one config source (removes the wrapper-vs-plugin ambiguity). The helper does a minimal JSON read (the wrapper cannot call the plugin's `loadConfig()` before it has located the plugin).
7. **Eliminate codexu's `--snapshot` delta at the source.** Fix `derive-next-command-cli.mjs` to default its snapshot path to `loadConfig({ repoRoot }).outputs.snapshot` (= `.ralph-overview/generated/snapshot.json`) instead of the stale `plans/overview-snapshot.json`. Verified: codexu's config `outputs.snapshot` already equals that path, so codexu's bespoke `--snapshot` injection becomes **unnecessary** — collapsing codexu's non-generic deltas from two to one (`localDevPluginRootRel`). This is the only behavioral change needed for codexu to be a generic consumer.
8. **Make one-shot `sync` work without chokidar (prerequisite for the diagnostic-only decision).** Lazy-load the watch module in `scripts/sync-ralph-state.mjs`: replace the top-level `import { start } from './lib/watch-ralph-state.mjs'` with a dynamic `await import('./lib/watch-ralph-state.mjs')` taken **only** on the `--watch` path. After this, a one-shot `sync` no longer evaluates `chokidar`, so a fresh Copilot install (no `node_modules`) can `sync` successfully and only `watch` surfaces the deps-missing diagnostic. Without this fix the "diagnostic-only" decision would leave fresh-install `sync` broken; with it, "chokidar is watch-only" is actually true.

### Reconciliation: auto-install vs diagnostic (REQUIRED DECISION)
**Decision: DIAGNOSTIC-ONLY**, conditioned on the lazy-load fix in Architecture #8. When the resolved install lacks `node_modules`, the wrapper warns and dispatches; it does **not** run `npm install`. One-shot `sync`/`build` work (after #8); only `watch` needs chokidar and surfaces the precise diagnostic. **Recommend archiving** the sibling task `ralph-overview-wrapper-auto-bootstrap-deps` as superseded by this work.

Rationale (all four research lenses + the brainstorm devil's-advocate lens agree): auto-running `npm install`/`npm ci` on the dispatch path is a footgun — (a) surprise multi-second/minute first-run latency and network dependency on an otherwise offline-capable command; (b) offline / registry-down hard-failure; (c) lockfile drift (`npm install` mutates the lock) vs `npm ci` (needs a committed lock the plugin install may not ship); (d) re-install-loop risk if the sentinel is imperfect; (e) `chokidar` is **watch-only** (true once #8 lands), so one-shot `sync` should never pay an install tax. A precise, copy-pasteable diagnostic is strictly safer and sufficient to unblock the operator. The sibling task's own kanban card flags this overlap and says "do NOT spawn an impl … until the ovinit plan resolves the approach" — this plan resolves it in favor of the diagnostic.

*(If the operator later wants self-healing fresh clones, the right future option is a plugin-author/publish-pipeline fix that ships `node_modules` — or a vendored chokidar — with the Copilot install, tracked separately as the brainstorm's out-of-scope "Copilot CLI plugin-install dependency gap" item, not an auto-install in the hot dispatch path.)*

### Dual-repo split (REQUIRED DECISION)
**Decision: TWO Ralph jobs.** A single `/implement-with-ralph` PRD covers one repo root; this work touches two (the `ai-developer-toolkit` submodule and codexu) with a hard ordering dependency. Recommended split:
- **Job A — plugin (`ai-developer-toolkit` submodule):** template + tests + init-consumer coupling/force-scoping + config schema + derive-next-command source fix + lazy-chokidar sync fix + overview-init SKILL docs/mirror + MCP surface + v2.9.0 lockstep + docs (installation.md, configuration.md, AGENTS.md invariant #4). Ships via the submodule two-commit flow + multi-remote push; consumers install from `gim-home`.
- **Job B — codexu adoption (after A ships + gitlink bump):** dry-run delta validation → wrapper-scoped emit (NO blanket `--force`) → add `.ralph-overview/config.json` `consumerWrapper.localDevPluginRootRel` → preserve the 2 extra package scripts → bump codexu `ai-developer-toolkit` gitlink to the v2.9.0 toolkit commit → update codexu AGENTS.md active-plugin-versions row to `2.9.0` + invariant #4 backlink → verify `pnpm sync-ralph-state` end-to-end. Codexu's `data.json`/`config.json` task content must be preserved.

Do **not** auto-chain this plan into a single `/implement-with-ralph` run.

## Scope

### In Scope
- The plugin-owned template wrapper + its unit tests (correct ESM guard, semver, liveness+diagnostic, config helper, signal forwarding).
- Coupled, force-scoped emit of wrapper + the 4 package scripts in `overview-init` (CLI + MCP + `initConsumer()`), never touching scaffold data/config.
- The two bug fixes (semver sort; manifest+dispatcher liveness + deps-missing diagnostic) + the lazy-chokidar sync fix that makes diagnostic-only sound.
- `.ralph-overview/config.json` `consumerWrapper.localDevPluginRootRel` hook (template + schema + schema test + docs).
- `derive-next-command-cli` snapshot-default source fix.
- overview-init SKILL.md + Copilot-mirror regeneration.
- v2.9.0 lockstep bump + docs + invariant #4 reword.
- codexu adoption via wrapper-scoped emit + config hook + gitlink bump + version-table update, preserving codexu task data.

### Out of Scope
- **Auto-`npm install`** on missing deps (decided diagnostic-only; recommend archiving the sibling task).
- The **Copilot-CLI plugin-install `node_modules` gap** itself (publish-pipeline issue; separate plugin-author follow-up).
- A **Copilot `$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT`-parity env var** feature request (out of band).
- `additionalProbePaths` config key (deferred — no current consumer).
- A dedicated `overview-init --diff` flag (Job B uses `--dry-run --json`).
- D-002 (absolute init-time paths) and D-003 (published npm/bin shim) — rejected per brainstorm.
- Auto-mutating existing consumers' `package.json` without an explicit `overview-init` run.

## Risk Areas
- **codexu data loss via `--force`** (the Critical finding): `force` overwrites `.ralph-overview/data.json`/`config.json` (init-consumer `:97-98`). Mitigation: wrapper emit is force-scoped independently (Arch #5); Job B never blanket-`--force`s; AC asserts codexu `data.json` byte-identical after adoption.
- **Diagnostic-only leaves fresh-install `sync` broken** unless chokidar is lazy-loaded (Arch #8 / sync static import at `sync-ralph-state.mjs:13` → `watch-ralph-state.mjs:6`). Mitigation: lazy-load + a sync-without-`node_modules` test.
- **ESM main-guard bug**: `import.meta.url === process.argv[1]` is always false. Mitigation: `fileURLToPath(import.meta.url) === path.resolve(process.argv[1])`; covered by a CLI spawn test that proves the emitted wrapper actually dispatches.
- **Half-state regression** if coupling is two independent ops — mitigated by the ordered preflight contract (Arch #4) + an atomicity test (inject wrapper-write failure → assert package.json untouched).
- **Schema rejection** of new config keys (`additionalProperties:false`) — update `overview-config.schema.json` + a validation test.
- **Stale skill docs** — regenerate overview-init SKILL.md + Copilot mirror (the flag/force semantics changed).
- **MCP build-cache reachability** — `launch.cjs` doesn't stage `templates/`; verify MCP-driven `overview.init` reads the new template via `RALPH_OVERVIEW_PLUGIN_ROOT` (AC + smoke).
- **CRLF / Windows paths** — `planTemplate` already normalizes `\r\n`; keep wrapper path resolution script-relative; beware CHANGELOG/`*.md` CRLF noise on staging (compare `--ignore-cr-at-eol`).
- **Submodule two-commit + multi-remote + gitlink ordering** — toolkit ships to `origin`/`personal`/`gim-home`; codexu AGENTS.md version row must not move to 2.9.0 before the gitlink points at the v2.9.0 commit.
- **Parity-test drift** — CLI/MCP/shared-engine init must report identical wrapper+script ops after coupling.

## Acceptance Criteria
*(Authoritative criteria live per-story in `stories-outline.md`; these are the plan-level rollups.)*
- Running `overview-init` (CLI, MCP `overview.init`, `initConsumer()`) into a fresh temp repo emits the wrapper **and** wrapper-pointing package scripts together; an injected wrapper-write failure leaves the package.json scripts **unmodified** (no scripts-without-wrapper half-state); when `package.json` is absent, neither is written.
- The emitted template (exact source) resolves correctly under hermetic tests (fake `HOME`, injected `env`, temp dirs) for: `RALPH_OVERVIEW_PLUGIN_ROOT` valid→resolves / invalid→warn+fall-through; `CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT` direct subdir→resolves; `CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT` cache versioned→newest by semver; `~/.claude` cache versioned→newest by semver; `~/.copilot` single dir→resolves; all-miss→exit 2 + friendly message; found-but-missing-dispatcher→exit 3; `--repo` present→preserved, absent→defaulted to git root.
- A CLI spawn test proves the emitted wrapper **actually dispatches** (the ESM main guard is correct) and forwards child exit code; `SIGINT` is forwarded to the child (and on Windows, `SIGTERM` best-effort/kill is documented).
- A Copilot-style install present-but-missing-`node_modules` is **still selected** and produces the "dependencies missing" diagnostic — not a silent fall-through.
- Semver ordering: a cache with `2.9.0` and `2.10.0` selects `2.10.0`.
- After the lazy-load fix, one-shot `sync` succeeds against a fake install whose `node_modules` is absent; `watch` against the same surfaces the deps-missing diagnostic.
- New `consumerWrapper.localDevPluginRootRel` validates against `overview-config.schema.json` (a schema test asserts acceptance); the wrapper honors it.
- `derive-next-command-cli.mjs` defaults the snapshot to `loadConfig().outputs.snapshot`; a test asserts the default path; codexu no longer needs `--snapshot` injection.
- Engine / MCP-shim / CLI-`--json` init parity test still passes; `overview-init` SKILL.md + Copilot mirror reflect the coupled-emit + force semantics.
- `plugin.json` v2.9.0 and all three marketplace indexes match; `node tools/validate-codex-marketplace-policy.mjs` passes; `npm test` + `npm run typecheck` green.
- (Job B) `overview-init --dry-run --json` against codexu reports planned changes to ONLY `bin/ralph-overview.mjs` + `package.json` (+ the intentional `config.json` `consumerWrapper` merge), with `.ralph-overview/data.json` skipped/unchanged (assert via JSON output + a sha256 of `data.json` before/after). After adoption, `pnpm sync-ralph-state` exits 0 end-to-end and a second invocation re-installs nothing; codexu's `data.json` is byte-identical to pre-adoption.
- (Job B) codexu `AGENTS.md` shows `ralph-overview 2.9.0` only after the `ai-developer-toolkit` gitlink points at the v2.9.0 toolkit commit.

Two clusters, one per repo, serialized (Job B depends on Job A shipping to the marketplace + the gitlink bump). Within Job A, US-001→US-002 are sequential (tests follow the template); US-003/US-004/US-005/US-006/US-007 share `init-consumer`/config/CLI/skill surfaces and the same version files, so they serialize inside the one plugin job (same-plugin parallel = version-file + AGENTS/CHANGELOG conflicts). US-008 is the lockstep finisher.

- Phase: 1
- Depends on: None
- File-overlap evidence: shared=[`scripts/init-consumer.mjs`, `.claude-plugin/plugin.json`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `AGENTS.md`, 3 marketplace indexes]; exclusive=[`templates/consumer-ralph-overview.mjs`, the new test file, `scripts/lib/derive-next-command-cli.mjs`, `scripts/sync-ralph-state.mjs`, `skills/overview-init/SKILL.md`]; risk=medium
- `execution_mode` rationale: All stories touch the same plugin plus the shared version/CHANGELOG/AGENTS/marketplace files, so they run serially inside ONE Ralph job to avoid version-file and doc-prepend conflicts.

### Cluster: codexu-adoption-B
- Stories: US-009, US-010, US-011
- Phase: 2
- Depends on: plugin-job-A
- File-overlap evidence: shared=[codexu `AGENTS.md`, codexu `package.json`, codexu `bin/ralph-overview.mjs`, codexu `.ralph-overview/config.json`]; exclusive=[]; risk=low
- `execution_mode` rationale: Adoption can only run after the plugin ships v2.9.0 to the marketplace and the codexu gitlink is bumped; it touches only codexu files and runs as a second, dependent Ralph job.

Parallel handoff: `/implement-with-ralph --from-plan .ralph/jobs/ralph-overview-init-consumer-cross-engine-wrapper/plan.md --parallel --suggested-decomposition .ralph/jobs/ralph-overview-init-consumer-cross-engine-wrapper/suggested-decomposition.json`

> NOTE: The two clusters are a **repo split**, not true parallelism. The recommended handoff is **two separate Ralph jobs** (Job A first; ship + gitlink bump; then Job B), NOT a single `--parallel` run — one PRD cannot span two repo roots with a cross-repo ship dependency.

## Open Questions
- **Wrapper default location** is `bin/` (continuity with codexu, the only consumer; `/bin` is no longer gitignored there). A future consumer with a `/bin` gitignore would need an un-ignore or a `scripts/` option — left as a single init option defaulting to `bin/` (deferred until a second consumer exists).
- **`overview-init --diff`** does not exist; Job B uses the existing `--dry-run --json`. A dedicated `--diff` is optional polish, not required.
- **Reconciliation action is a bookkeeper/lead step**, not an impl story: after this plan's approach is accepted, the lead should flip `ralph-overview-wrapper-auto-bootstrap-deps` to `lifecycle: archived` in `.ralph-overview/data.json` with a "superseded by ralph-overview-init-consumer-cross-engine-wrapper (diagnostic-only + lazy-chokidar)" note. Flagged so it isn't lost.
- **Emit-time substitution vs constant block** for marketplace/plugin names — recommend emit-time substitution; final choice is an implementation detail for US-003.

## Next Step
This work ships as TWO Ralph jobs. After the lead fast-forwards the plan branch to main:
- Job A (plugin): `Skill("ralph-orchestration:implement-with-ralph", args="--from-plan .ralph/jobs/ralph-overview-init-consumer-cross-engine-wrapper/plan.md")` scoped to the `ai-developer-toolkit` submodule stories (US-001..US-008).
- Job B (codexu adoption): run after Job A ships v2.9.0 to the marketplace and the codexu gitlink is bumped (US-009..US-011).

After merging, clean up the plan worktree with `/plan-with-ralph cleanup ralph-overview-init-consumer-cross-engine-wrapper`.
